newsitem.title: FRANCE: French government seeks input on generic medicines.
newsitem.headline: French government seeks input on generic medicines.

text.p: Labour and Social Affairs Minister Jacques Barrot said on Wednesday that he had written to the medical profession for their input on the conditions under which France's drugs sector should be opened to generic medicines.
In a statement, Barrot said the idea was to introduce over time the right of pharmacists to substitute a generic drug for a prescribed name brand.
The statement said the government would accept opinions on the matter until October 21 from doctors, pharmacists, drugs wholesalers and pharmaceutical laboratories.
